identity.title: Kinematic detection of a planet carving a gap in a protoplanetary disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: Here we report the kinematic detection of a few Jupiter-mass planet located in a gas and dust gap at 130 au in the disc surrounding the young star HD 97048.

evidence.quote: HD 97048 is located in the Chameleon I cloud, at a distance of 185 pc (cite: Gaia-Collaboration2018).
HD 97048 is located in the Chameleon I cloud, at a distance of 185 pc (cite: Gaia-Collaboration2018).

question.value: Is a localised deviation from Keplerian flow in 13CO emission of HD 97048 spatially coincident with a dust gap, indicating an embedded planet, and what is its mass?

evidence.quote: An embedded planet can explain both the disturbed Keplerian flow of the gas, detected in CO lines, and the gap detected in the dust disc at the same radius.
(ALMA program #2016.1.00826.S, PI: G. van der Plas)
We observed HD 97048 with ALMA in band 7 in the C40-4 (1 execution) and C40-7 (2 executions) configurations

evidence.quote: with an individual channel width of 122 kHz, resulting in a 244 kHz spectral resolution (220 m s$^{-1}$) after Hanning smoothing.
One of the spectral windows for each observation was centered at the $^{13}$CO J=3-2 rest frequency
The three other spectral windows were used for continuum with a bandwidth of 1.875 GHz each.
in the C40-4 (1 execution) and C40-7 (2 executions) configurations

reaching a total time on source of 112 minutes

findings_qualitative.value: Velocity kink in the upper 13CO surface is coincident with the continuum gap; the opposite side shows no kink, excluding axisymmetric or large-scale mechanisms.

evidence.quote: This excludes a large scale perturbation of the disc or an azimuthally symmetric mechanism.

findings_qualitative.value: Emitting grains need a low Stokes number, suggesting fluffy aggregates

evidence.quote: Another possibility is that dust grains of a few 100 microns or millimetres in size consist of fluffy aggregates

why_this_method.value: Search for the dynamical effect of a planet on the gas disc, detectable in high spectral and spatial resolution line data

evidence.quote: Our approach is to search for the dynamical effect of a planet on the surrounding gas disc.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Pressure bumps, gravitational instability and companion/flyby are rejected since they give axisymmetric or large-scale structures

evidence.quote: While those pressure bumps produce deviations from Keplerian velocity, they are axisymmetric.
